Define an explicit fixed GenErik DJ layout, not Serato Studio emulation: pages1/2 eight cues per A/B or C/D; pages3/4 eight fixed loops; pages5/6 eight signed beat jumps; pages7/8 Play, held Cue, Sync, Keylock, PFL, loop toggle, Load and tempo reset per deck. Top eight physical pads address the first deck; bottom eight the second. Native normal Play controls A. DIAL-mode knob sends1/65 on CC60 for browsing; its press opens a group. Arrows browse one track. Encoders CC16-19 use1/65 for A level/filter and B filter/level. Mode1 strip is channel7 CC14/46 paired14-bit crossfader. Four page-change button variants on channel7 Notes83-86 retire source-local holds and reset deck edges on press. Both physical Shift transitions on channel1 Note70 retire holds and gate native inputs, avoiding stranded Cue when its release arrives on the unsupported Shift pad channel. Page-button releases do not retire new holds. C/D retain app opt-in. Source application/encoder modes, record/undo/redo, shifted functions, aftertouch, Mode2 strip, touch interpretation, colour feedback, screens, full lifecycle and physical/A10X acceptance remain open. Use native A-D gain/EQ/Color/level, TOGGLE CUE state and master/headphone/crossfader controls on manually selected MIDI channel1. source.review: All three E1 pages were visually reviewed. Decks use channels1/2; mixer channel5; normal pads channels6/7; Shift pads channels8/9. Input-only PC Control CC100 must report127 independently from both decks before one paired-output Mixer Mode CC101=0 requests MIDI Control. The decoder marks local readiness only after the send succeeds, without claiming a device acknowledgement. Any deck leaving PC mode gates controls and releases holds. Nonzero mixer mode gates controls without fighting the physical choice. The user can restore MIDI Control explicitly or re-enter PC mode. No guessed XDJ-AN mode value or shutdown write is sent. Source-selected Software Control and LOAD1/2 are physical steps. Current manual explicitly describes USB-C iPhone/iPad, not Lightning/A10X qualification. Tempo uses non-inverted paired14-bit CC0/32; jogs use documented centre64 difference counts, with physical resolution/range calibration open. Main Cue is held; both Shift transitions retire side-local holds. Normal hot cues, fixed native eight-pad loops and signed jumps are distinct pages; mode presses retire held actions. Mixer/PFL and exact127/0 Play/Cue/Sync/Keylock lamps use independently listed addresses. Remaining pad/effect/keyboard modes, ambiguous binary BeatLoop rotation, source tempo range switches, touch interpretation, meters/screens, audio routes, ownership timing/cold notifications, full lifecycle and physical acceptance remain open.
